description: This file defines thread-local management structures and RAII guards for handling DispatchKeySets in the PyTorch framework, including thread-local variables, guard classes, and API functions for dispatch key management.

classes.name: PODLocalDispatchKeySet
classes.description: A Plain Old Data (POD) struct encapsulating included and excluded dispatch key bitsets with methods to get and set them, used for thread-local dispatch key management.

classes.name: LocalDispatchKeySet
classes.description: A struct combining included and excluded DispatchKeySets, constructed from PODLocalDispatchKeySet, representing thread-local dispatch key state.

classes.name: IncludeDispatchKeyGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class for temporarily including a dispatch key set within a scope.

classes.name: ExcludeDispatchKeyGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class for temporarily excluding a dispatch key set within a scope.

classes.name: ForceDispatchKeyGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class for forcibly setting dispatch key sets, restoring previous state upon destruction.

methods.name: included
methods.description: Returns the included dispatch key set, XORed with the default included set.

methods.name: excluded
methods.description: Returns the excluded dispatch key set, XORed with the default excluded set.

methods.name: set_included
methods.description: Sets the included dispatch key set from a DispatchKeySet.

methods.name: set_excluded
methods.description: Sets the excluded dispatch key set from a DispatchKeySet.
